item.title: Compact Varistors For High Surge Protection
item.description: A component protects electronic systems from power surges. It helps improve safety in power, industrial, and communication systems. TDK Corporation has introduced the MT40 series of ThermoFuse varistors, designed to protect electronic systems from high-energy surges. The components can handle peak surge currents of up to 50 kA and short-circuit currents up to 200 kA […]

item.title: Wearable Sensor Detects Small Body Vibrations
item.description: A wearable sensor detects vibrations from breathing, speaking, swallowing, and coughing. It works without external power and can help monitor body signals in health devices.
